# 14B model evaluation (SFT or RSFT)
# Usage: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=X bash scripts/eval_14b.sh

echo "  SFT Adapter:${SFT_ADAPTER:-none}"
echo "  Base:       ${BASE_MODEL}"
